title: ngsRelate per-pair relatedness output
description: One row per sample pair from ngsRelate (ANGSD-Korneliussen). The atlas reads this file as Mode B (raw-folder interface): the resolver-registry parses the TSV, applies optional column filtering via the layer entry's `fields:` field, and returns an array of row objects with numeric coercion. See data/relatedness/README.md for the canonical column set and run-folder convention.
_layer_doc: This schema describes the row shape. It is registered against layer 'relatedness_ngsrelate' in inversion-atlas/atlases/inversion/registries/data/layers.registry.json. Until a real <run_id>/relatedness.tsv lands in data/relatedness/ngsrelate/, the layer's schema_status is 'pending' and any row shape is accepted (per registry_core.schema.json convention). When real data lands, flip schema_status to 'validated' and the resolver will reject malformed rows.

a.description: First sample index, 0-based, into the run's samples.txt.

b.description: Second sample index. Convention: a < b.

nSites.description: Number of sites compared for this pair.

FDiff.description: F differential between Fa and Fb.

loglh.description: Optimised log-likelihood for this pair's IBD model.

coverage.description: Mean per-site coverage across the pair's sites.

R0.description: IBS-derived ratio used for PO/FS discrimination.

R1.description: IBS-derived ratio used for PO/FS discrimination.

KING.description: KING-robust kinship estimator. Useful threshold cuts: PO/FS ≥ 0.177, 2nd ≥ 0.0884, 3rd ≥ 0.0442 (Manichaikul et al. 2010).
